annotations.title: Take a number offline without unlinking it

description:
Take a number offline deliberately, keeping its link to the phone.

The stored credentials survive, so `connect_number` brings it straight
back with no pairing. Nothing is deleted. Disconnecting does not stop billing:
an extra number is billed every cycle until it is removed.

Returns immediately, before the number is offline. The answer has the
number's `alias`, `status` set to `disconnecting` and `at`, the moment the
request was accepted. `disconnecting` is not a status that `get_number`
reports: it keeps showing the previous status and its own `at` until the
number is offline.

While disconnected the number cannot send or receive, and messages
addressed to it are refused rather than queued. Deliberate: a message
held for an unknown period and delivered later is worse than one that
failed clearly.

Calling it again changes nothing further. A number that is already
offline answers with an `already_disconnected` error, which means the
goal is met, not that the call failed.
